JOIN demo.customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN demo.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE
  o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.ordered_at >= '2025-11-01'::date
  AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'::date
GROUP BY
  c.region
ORDER BY
  c.region ASC
